instruction: A candid outdoor full shot captures three friends celebrating on a grassy park field. On the left, the woman with a large afro in a red t-shirt (R6) stands clapping and smiling. In the center, the man in a red polo shirt (R3) stands with his arms outstretched, smiling happily. On the right, the woman in a red t-shirt and black beanie (R5) stands smiling and dancing. The three are aligned horizontally, sharing a joyful moment under soft daylight filtering through the background trees, casting a warm glow over the green grass.
